河北省发展和改革委员会关于优化调整河北南网工商业及其他用户分时电价政策的通知

notes: Float base = 当月平均购电价格 (one constant per month, NOT 代理购电价格+输配电价): 高峰/低谷 = 平段 ± 70%·base, 尖峰 = 平段 + 0.7·base + 20%·(1.7·base), 深谷 = 平段 − 0.7·base − 20%·(0.3·base). 线损、输配电价、系统运行费、基金、历史偏差电费折价 do not float.

The notice prints 尖峰 and 深谷 prices for every row and every month (also 不满1千伏 and months without such a period); they are stored as printed. Per 1115号 不满1千伏 users do NOT execute 尖峰/深谷, and a price only applies in months whose season has that period (尖峰: 6-8、12-2月; 深谷: 3-5、9-11月). Notice note 4: in 3-5、9-11月 meters show the 深谷 period in the '尖峰' register.
Scope: all 代理购电 工商业 users in 河北南网 execute TOU; 行政机关、医院 etc. may opt in. Direct market participants follow the 2026 河北南部电网中长期交易工作方案 instead.

Layout: 3rd TDP period (to 2026-07, 冀发改能价〔2023〕646号) 单一制 5 rows + 两部制 4 rows (no 两部制 不满1千伏); 4th period (2026-08 →, 冀发改能价〔2026〕691号) 两部制 gains 不满1千伏 (10 rows) and 需量/容量 prices change. 1.5倍 and 转供电 tables on the poster are not loaded.

Source: he.sgcc.com.cn col466 attachments – one-page image-only PDF posters; OCR'd with tesseract and cross-validated (component sum, monthly float base, voltage monotonicity); 2025-11 and 2026-08 visually verified against the poster.
